scripts.build: npm run build --workspace backend && npm --prefix apps/frontend/my-app run build -- --webpack
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace @rescom/schemas && npm run typecheck --workspace backend && npm --prefix apps/frontend/my-app run typecheck
scripts.lint: npm run lint --workspace backend && npm --prefix apps/frontend/my-app run lint
scripts.test: npm test --workspace @rescom/schemas && npm test --workspace backend && npm --prefix apps/frontend/my-app test
scripts.verify: npm run build && npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm test
